lines.zh: 煤灰从我身上抖落，留一串黑印。
lines.en: Coal dust falls off me and leaves a trail of black marks.

lines.zh: 我踩过的草都染上墨色，洗不掉的。
lines.en: Grass I step on turns ink-black and never washes clean.

lines.zh: 我走得沉，像拖着一整座煤窑。
lines.en: I walk heavily, like dragging a whole coal pit.

lines.zh: 异位的风把我的黑烟吹向前方。
lines.en: The Nowhere wind blows my black smoke ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我每迈一步，爪缝里就漏出煤屑。
lines.en: With every step, coal grit leaks from between my claws.

lines.zh: 我不跑，慢慢压过去就够了。
lines.en: I do not run; a slow, heavy advance is enough.

lines.zh: 我沿着黑苔痕走，那是我来时的路。
lines.en: I follow black moss stains, the road I came by.

lines.zh: 影子拖在身后，比我的身体还黑。
lines.en: My shadow trails behind me, blacker than my body.

lines.zh: 脚步很钝，像煤块砸在石板上。
lines.en: My steps land dull, like coal hitting stone slabs.

lines.zh: 我绕开亮处，光会刺这身煤皮。
lines.en: I avoid the bright ground; light stings this coal hide.

lines.zh: 我走路带响，那声音像磨黑的石头。
lines.en: I walk loudly, like blackened stone grinding together.

lines.zh: 像印泥一样，我在地上盖出自己的路。
lines.en: Like an ink pad, I stamp my own road on the ground.

lines.zh: 我把手插进煤堆，找最硬的一块。
lines.en: I dig my hands into coal heaps for the hardest lump.

lines.zh: 我数身上的黑斑，数到一半就乱了。
lines.en: I count my black patches and lose track halfway.

lines.zh: 安静时，我能听见体内晶体轻响。
lines.en: At rest, I hear the small crystal ringing inside me.

lines.zh: 我从爪缝里抠出染料，抹在石头上。
lines.en: I scrape dye from my claws and smear it on stone.

lines.zh: 异位没有白天，我照样眯着眼。
lines.en: Nowhere has no daytime, yet I still squint.

lines.zh: 我坐着，煤灰在肩上积成薄薄一层。
lines.en: I sit while coal dust piles thinly on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我把一块煤翻来覆去，舍不得扔。
lines.en: I turn a lump of coal over, unwilling to drop it.

lines.zh: 身上的黑会渗出来，在脚边结成块。
lines.en: The black seeps out of me and hardens at my feet.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，喉里全是煤烟味。
lines.en: I yawn, and coal smoke fills my throat.

lines.zh: 我盯着暗处，那里有东西在动。
lines.en: I stare into the dark, where something stirs.

lines.zh: 你太白了，在这到处是黑的地方。
lines.en: You are far too white for a place this black.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，你正低头看脚下的煤。
lines.en: I look up as you look down at the coal.

lines.zh: 我盯你，像盯一块还没烧透的煤。
lines.en: I stare at you like coal not yet burned through.

lines.zh: 你的火把照到我脸上，我眯了一下。
lines.en: Your torchlight hits my face, and I squint.

lines.zh: 我看见你项上的皮肤，很干净。
lines.en: I see the skin of your throat, and it is clean.

lines.zh: 默克这名字，是别人给我起的。
lines.en: Merkyre is a name someone else gave me.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，黑水滴在地上。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you, black water dripping down.

lines.zh: 别擦汗，我喜欢看人紧张。
lines.en: Do not wipe your sweat; I like watching people tense.

lines.zh: 你在找门，可这地方没有门。
lines.en: You are looking for a door; this place has none.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，比煤更招我。
lines.en: The iron smell on you draws me more than coal.

lines.zh: 你的刀在我身上留下一道灰痕。
lines.en: Your blade leaves a grey line across me.

lines.zh: 疼，但黑水很快就把它盖住。
lines.en: It hurts, but black water soon covers it.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，脚陷进煤渣里。
lines.en: I step back once and sink into coal slag.

lines.zh: 这一箭插得很深，我不拔。
lines.en: This arrow went deep, and I will not pull it out.

lines.zh: 我的血黑得像煤浆，流得很慢。
lines.en: My blood is black as coal slurry and runs slow.

lines.zh: 这一刀真砍进来了，稀奇。
lines.en: A blade actually got through. How strange.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，像煤块裂开。
lines.en: I grunt, like a lump of coal splitting.

lines.zh: 别急着补刀，我还能站。
lines.en: Do not rush the last blow; I can still stand.

lines.zh: 肩膀麻了，爪子还抬得起来。
lines.en: My shoulder is numb, but the claws still rise.

lines.zh: 这一下的分量，我刻在爪上。
lines.en: I carve the weight of that blow into my claw.

lines.zh: 把那点吃的收起来，我啃煤就够了。
lines.en: Put that food away; chewing coal is enough for me.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是想找个东西咬。
lines.en: I am not hungry; I only want something to bite.

lines.zh: 你晃着胡萝卜，我的眼睛跟着你的手。
lines.en: You wave a carrot; my eyes follow your hand.

lines.zh: 别喂我，喂进去的都会变成黑水。
lines.en: Do not feed me; whatever goes in comes out black.

lines.zh: 一块煤对我，比任何食物都香。
lines.en: A lump of coal smells better to me than any meal.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西太干净，我不吃。
lines.en: What you hold is too clean; I will not eat it.

lines.zh: 我宁愿吞一把煤屑，也不要你的苹果。
lines.en: I would rather swallow coal grit than your apple.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，你先看见的是一口黑牙。
lines.en: I open my mouth, and you see a row of black teeth.

lines.zh: 食物会让我变慢，我不需要慢。
lines.en: Food would slow me down, and I do not want slow.

lines.zh: 你要是把煤递过来，我就当你是朋友。
lines.en: Hand me coal, and I will count you a friend.

lines.zh: 撞上我，你的袖子会留下黑印。
lines.en: Bump into me, and your sleeve keeps a black print.

lines.zh: 我像一堵会走路的煤墙。
lines.en: I am a walking wall made of coal.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我身上掉下一层灰。
lines.en: You crash into me, and a layer of soot falls off.

lines.zh: 别蹭，我身上的染料洗不掉。
lines.en: Do not rub against me; this dye does not wash out.

lines.zh: 我比看起来重，站得也比你稳。
lines.en: I am heavier than I look, and I stand steadier.

lines.zh: 一撞你手上就有灰，别用舌头舔。
lines.en: One bump leaves soot on your hand. Do not lick it.

lines.zh: 我被撞退半步，指甲刮进泥里。
lines.en: I slide back half a step, nails digging into mud.

lines.zh: 这身黑皮很硬，撞疼的是你。
lines.en: This black hide is hard, so the ache is yours.

lines.zh: 我们的影子叠在一起，全是黑的。
lines.en: Our shadows overlap, and both of them are black.

lines.zh: 你再挤，我就把你按进煤堆里。
lines.en: Push again, and I will press you into the coal heap.

lines.zh: 我们这一族不成对，只抢煤。
lines.en: My kind never pair up; we only fight over coal.

lines.zh: 同类相见，先比谁的皮更黑。
lines.en: When kin meet, we compare whose hide is blacker.

lines.zh: 两个默克贴太久，会黏成一团黑。
lines.en: Two Merkyres that touch too long fuse into black.

lines.zh: 我不找伴侣，我只找下一个煤堆。
lines.en: I seek no partner, only the next heap of coal.

lines.zh: 黑水里没有爱情，只有沉下去的东西。
lines.en: There is no love in black water, only sunken things.

lines.zh: 我独自守着这块黑地，很久了。
lines.en: I have guarded this black ground alone a long while.

lines.zh: 谁想和我配对，先挨我一爪。
lines.en: Whoever wants to pair with me must take a claw first.

lines.zh: 我的后代自己会从煤里爬出来。
lines.en: My offspring will crawl out of the coal by themselves.

lines.zh: 分开时，地上留下两块黑渍。
lines.en: When we part, two black stains remain on the ground.

lines.zh: 别靠那么近，我不习惯有同伴。
lines.en: Not so close; I am not used to companions.

lines.zh: 我只捡黑色的东西。
lines.en: I pick up only things that are black.

lines.zh: 这块煤归我了，你松手。
lines.en: This coal is mine now. Let go.

lines.zh: 我抓东西不用手，用整条胳膊。
lines.en: I do not grip with hands; I use my whole arm.

lines.zh: 你的剑掉在地上，我先踩住。
lines.en: Your sword falls, and I plant a foot on it.

lines.zh: 我把染料块塞进身上的缝里。
lines.en: I stuff the dye lump into a seam of my body.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，我都要闻一遍。
lines.en: Whatever drops, I sniff it once.

lines.zh: 这枚晶体太小，我懒得捡。
lines.en: This crystal is too small to bother picking up.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，是打算砸你。
lines.en: If I pick it up, it is to throw it at you.

lines.zh: 地上留了黑手印，那是我拿过。
lines.en: A black handprint on the ground means I took it.

lines.zh: 我不收藏，我只是不想留给你。
lines.en: I do not collect; I just will not leave it to you.

lines.zh: 你踩进这片黑地，就归我了。
lines.en: You stepped onto this black ground, so you are mine.

lines.zh: 我闻到活物的味道，很新鲜。
lines.en: I smell something living, and it is fresh.

lines.zh: 你回头那一下，我已经开始走。
lines.en: The moment you turned back, I started walking.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在泥里收紧，选好了。
lines.en: My claws tighten in the mud; I have chosen.

lines.zh: 你身上的白，在黑地里太显眼。
lines.en: Your whiteness stands out far too much on black ground.

lines.zh: 我不挑食，但我挑跑得慢的。
lines.en: I am not picky, but I do favor the slow runners.

lines.zh: 你踩碎一块煤，那声音我听见了。
lines.en: You crushed a piece of coal, and I heard it.

lines.zh: 我盯上你，因为你没往这边看。
lines.en: I fix on you because you are not looking this way.

lines.zh: 这块地的规矩：进来的都要留下。
lines.en: The rule here: whatever enters stays.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处，你已在视线里。
lines.en: My eyes are in the dark; you are already in sight.

lines.zh: 别装没看见我，我一直都在。
lines.en: Do not pretend you missed me; I have always been here.

lines.zh: 选择很快，收尾很慢，你等着。
lines.en: Choosing is quick; finishing is slow. Wait.

lines.zh: 我的黑血在响，它闻到了你。
lines.en: My black blood hums; it has smelled you.

lines.zh: 你走进来，我就省了一段路。
lines.en: You walked in, saving me a stretch of road.

lines.zh: 你身上那股铁味，太响了。
lines.en: That iron smell on you is far too loud.

lines.zh: 我认得你走路的调子。
lines.en: I know the rhythm of your walk.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压过去，你退得更快。
lines.en: I press forward step by step; you retreat faster.

lines.zh: 我的黑影先一步铺到你鞋上。
lines.en: My dark shadow spreads over your boots before I arrive.

lines.zh: 我不急，黑色的东西都很有耐心。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; black things are patient.

lines.zh: 你举盾的姿势，右边空着。
lines.en: The way you hold that shield leaves your right open.

lines.zh: 我把重心压低，准备撞过来。
lines.en: I drop my weight low, ready to charge.

lines.zh: 你在数我的脚步，已经数乱了吧。
lines.en: You are counting my steps, and you have lost count.

lines.zh: 我的爪子刮着地，像在磨刀。
lines.en: My claws scrape the ground like a whetstone.

lines.zh: 你退到石头边，就没有路了。
lines.en: Back up to the stone, and your road ends.

lines.zh: 煤灰落在我肩上，我不管它。
lines.en: Coal dust settles on my shoulders, and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我绕半圈，把你堵在暗处。
lines.en: I circle halfway and pen you in the dark.

lines.zh: 你屏住呼吸，可我听的是心跳。
lines.en: You hold your breath, but I listen to your heart.

lines.zh: 我不看你的脸，我看你的膝盖。
lines.en: I do not watch your face; I watch your knees.

lines.zh: 我算好了撞的角度，你别动。
lines.en: I have worked out the angle of impact. Be still.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把越来越低了。
lines.en: The torch in your hand is sinking lower.

lines.zh: 爪子插进土里，磨到发亮。
lines.en: I dig my claws into the soil and hone them bright.

lines.zh: 你手里有火把，我讨厌光。
lines.en: You carry a torch. I hate the light.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根靠近。
lines.en: I come along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 再一步，你就进我的圈子。
lines.en: One more step puts you inside my circle.

lines.zh: 我歪头，听你的心跳。
lines.en: I tilt my head and listen to your heart.

lines.zh: 煤灰落在我肩上，我不抖。
lines.en: Coal dust settles on my shoulder. I do not shake it off.

lines.zh: 我一爪下去，煤灰和血一起飞。
lines.en: One claw stroke, and coal dust flies with blood.

lines.zh: 爪子能挡，压下来的煤身挡不住。
lines.en: You can parry claws, not the coal weight pressing down.

lines.zh: 我撞在你胸口，你听见骨头响。
lines.en: I slam your chest, and you hear your bones answer.

lines.zh: 这一下带着煤渣，伤口会发黑。
lines.en: This blow carries coal grit; the wound will blacken.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我又跟上一步。
lines.en: You fall back two steps; I take one more.

lines.zh: 我不喊，打人的时候我最安静。
lines.en: I do not shout; I am quietest when striking.

lines.zh: 你的护甲凹了，像被煤块砸的。
lines.en: Your armor dents as if struck by a lump of coal.

lines.zh: 我把你按在石头上，指甲往里走。
lines.en: I pin you to the stone and drive my nails in.

lines.zh: 这一爪是给你的煤，收好。
lines.en: Here is your coal, delivered by claw. Keep it.

lines.zh: 你血里的铁味，让我更饿了。
lines.en: The iron in your blood makes me hungrier.

lines.zh: 我打得不好看，但打得很实。
lines.en: I do not fight prettily, but I hit solidly.

lines.zh: 你挥手反击，正好擦过我的肩。
lines.en: You swing back, and it grazes my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我倒退，是因为这一下用力太猛。
lines.en: I stagger back because I struck too hard.

lines.zh: 别抹伤口，黑色会留在里面。
lines.en: Do not wipe that cut; the black stays inside.

lines.zh: 我的爪从你的盾上滑过。
lines.en: My claws skate across your shield.

lines.zh: 我撞进你的怀里，很沉。
lines.en: I drive into your chest, heavy as stone.

lines.zh: 这一击带起一片煤屑。
lines.en: The blow throws up a spray of coal.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我跟了两步。
lines.en: You give two steps. I take two.

lines.zh: 我按住你的手腕，往下压。
lines.en: I pin your wrist and press it down.

lines.zh: 你掉了一地的黑灰。
lines.en: You leave a trail of black ash.

lines.zh: 异位的黑土裂开，我爬了出来。
lines.en: The black soil of Nowhere splits, and I crawl out.

lines.zh: 我先有了爪，然后才有了身体。
lines.en: First came the claws, then came the body.

lines.zh: 煤堆里多了一双手，那就是我。
lines.en: A pair of hands appeared in the coal heap. That is me.

lines.zh: 这里很暗，正合我的意思。
lines.en: It is dark here, which suits me perfectly.

lines.zh: 我从地缝里把自己撑起来。
lines.en: I push myself up out of a seam in the ground.

lines.zh: 我出生时，地上留了一摊黑水。
lines.en: When I was born, a pool of black water remained.

lines.zh: 没有雷，也没有光，我就到了。
lines.en: No thunder and no light; I simply arrived.

lines.zh: 这块黑地终于有了主人。
lines.en: This black ground finally has an owner.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气，闻起来像煤。
lines.en: My first breath smelled like coal.

lines.zh: 我先学会抓，然后才学会走。
lines.en: I learned to grasp before I learned to walk.

lines.zh: 你听见的沙沙声，是我在起身。
lines.en: That rustling sound is me getting to my feet.

lines.zh: 我站直的时候，影子比我先动。
lines.en: As I straighten up, my shadow moves before I do.

lines.zh: 火烧不透煤，只把我烤得更硬。
lines.en: Fire cannot burn through coal; it bakes me harder.

lines.zh: 我摔进坑里，煤灰扬起一片。
lines.en: I fall into a pit and raise a cloud of coal dust.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的黑漫开一圈。
lines.en: Water pours in, and my black spreads in a ring.

lines.zh: 气浪掀走了我半身煤灰。
lines.en: The blast strips half the soot off me.

lines.zh: 你的箭比我的爪子快。
lines.en: Your arrow is faster than my claws.

lines.zh: 药水在我身上冒起黑烟。
lines.en: Potion hisses into black smoke on my hide.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可这身体还是会饿。
lines.en: I eat nothing, yet this body still hungers.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，煤味更浓了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me, and the coal smell thickens.

lines.zh: 往下掉时，我什么都没抓住。
lines.en: As I fall, I catch hold of nothing.
